title: will / going to / Present Continuous / Present Simple
instructions: Elegí la forma de futuro correcta. Primero identificá la intención: ¿predicción, plan, arreglo o horario?

items.q: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ any minute now.
items.e: Evidencia visible ahora → be going to.

items.q: The train ___ at 7:30, so don't be late.
I ___ my friends at 6 PM at the café.
items.e: Arreglo ya organizado (hora + personas) → Present Continuous.

items.q: I think our company ___ launch a new version next year.
A: I've forgotten my charger. B: Don't worry, I ___ you mine.
We ___ the new office next Tuesday at 10. Everything is arranged.
items.e: Ya organizado con día y hora → Present Continuous.

items.q: We ___ move to a bigger office, but we haven't decided when.
items.e: Decisión tomada pero sin fecha → be going to.

items.q: The conference ___ on 12 May. Here is the schedule.
I'm sure she ___ the exam.
Watch out! You ___ that glass!
items.e: Va a pasar algo y se ve ahora → going to.

title: Future forms: escribí la forma
instructions: Completá con la forma de futuro más adecuada del verbo entre paréntesis.
text:
1. Look at the sky! It [1] (rain).
2. The bus [2] (leave) at 9 a.m.
3. I [3] (meet) my accountant tomorrow at 9.
4. A: There's no milk. B: I [4] (buy) some.
5. I think she [5] (win) the competition.
6. We [6] (get) married in Spain on July 24th.
7. I [7] (read) War and Peace this weekend. I've already bought it.
8. It [8] (be) my birthday tomorrow.

items.e: Evidencia visible (Look at the sky!) → is going to + base.
Arreglo con hora y persona → am + -ing.
Decisión espontánea, en el momento → will.
Fecha y lugar confirmados → Present Continuous.

pat: ^am going to reading$|^am go to read$|^am going read$
items.e: Intención con decisión ya tomada (ya lo compré) → be going to.

title: Future forms: preguntas y negaciones
instructions: Escribí la pregunta o negación con la forma de futuro correcta.
text:
1. [1] (you / attend) the conference next month?
2. She [2] (not / win). I'm sure of it.
3. [3] (it / rain) tomorrow?
4. We [4] (not / attend) the workshop. We've already decided.
5. What time [5] (you / meet) the client tomorrow?

pat: ^are you going to attending$|^are you going attend$
^aren't going to attending$|^aren't go to attend$
items.e: Decisión ya tomada → aren't going to + base.
Arreglo con hora ('What time') → are you + -ing.

title: ¿Qué forma de futuro es?
instructions: Elegí la forma de futuro de la parte en negrita.

items.q: I think it **will rain** tomorrow.
Look at those clouds — it **is going to rain**.
I **am meeting** my boss at 9 tomorrow.
The train **leaves** at 9 a.m.
OK, I**'ll help** you with that.
We **are going to** get married, but we don't know when.
They **are flying** to Australia tomorrow.
items.e: Vuelo ya organizado (ejemplo de tus apuntes).

items.q: It **is** Christmas next week!
Elegí la correcta:
o: I think it will to rain.
items.e: Después de will siempre verbo base.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
Elegí la correcta (horario fijo):
o: The train will leave at 9am, according to the timetable.
The train leaves at 9am, according to the timetable.
The train is leave at 9am, according to the timetable.
items.a: The train leaves at 9am, according to the timetable.
items.e: Horarios fijos → Present Simple, no will (Unit3/01).

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: Look at the sky, it will rain.
Look at the sky, it's going to rain.
Look at the sky, it rain.
items.a: Look at the sky, it's going to rain.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: I'm having coffee with my boss tomorrow.
I having coffee with my boss tomorrow.
I'm have coffee with my boss tomorrow.
items.a: I'm having coffee with my boss tomorrow.
